chunks: And the day when it shines in all its glory,

key_terms.تَجَلَّىٰ: It shone / It became manifest / It revealed its glory

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the glory of the day in Surah Al-Layl?
ai.summary: This fragment from Surah Al-Layl (92:1) captures the divine oath regarding the day's radiance (tajalla), which Shia exegetes like Al-Tabarsi interpret as a manifestation of God's majesty and a sign of His creative power. It serves as a rhetorical device to urge reflection on the natural order, contrasting the day's light with the night's darkness to highlight the balance in creation.
